{{Top}}
'''Yeoman''' was a military rank or title in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]], [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|Navy]] and [[New Republic Honor Guard|Honor Guard]]. Their duties included military and bodyguard service.
